title: docs: architect.md tells seats to read error.data.nextAction on a MoeError although error.data is exactly { tool, codeName }, and the QA landing-gap reject (qa.reference.md, moe-qa-loop) puts the held-path remedy into one issue description, which qa_reject refuses past 500 characters
description:
Defect hunt #8 (task-21d671c1), lane 3: role docs and skills checked against the runtime. HEAD b5f40fee.

PROBLEM
1. architect.md, the MoeError rule.
   - docs/roles/architect.md:30 says "On `MoeError`, read `error.data.nextAction` and do what it says." The line arrived in b4d3b91a (2026-05-08), and its vendored copy is packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts:55.
   - McpAdapter sends a MoeError as `errorResponse(id, code, message, { tool: params.name, codeName: toolError.codeName })` (packages/moe-daemon/src/server/McpAdapter.ts:316-323).
   - docs/MCP_SERVER.md:91 agrees with the code: "`error.data` is exactly `{ tool, codeName }` … `MoeError.context` is logged in the daemon and never sent, so clients key on `data.codeName` and read details from the message". For that reason, util/enforcement.ts:71-72 puts the claim call in the message text.
   - So every architect seat looks for a recovery field that never arrives, while the real next call sits in `error.message`. A retryable refusal such as TASK_NOT_CLAIMED or ATTEMPT_FINALIZING then reads as a dead end.
   - worker.md, qa.md and governor.md have no such line.
2. The QA landing-gap reject.
   - docs/roles/qa.reference.md:46-50 tells QA to call moe.qa_reject with ONE issue of type `other`. Its description starts `Landing gap:` and cites lastCommitOutcome, landingRetry, each rescue ref, and "the row's paths that are still dirty, with any held-path remedy its landing printed (`MOE_CONTESTED_HELD`)".
   - docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md:61 says the same: "the row's still-dirty paths with their remedy (`MOE_CONTESTED_HELD`)".
   - qaReject.ts:103-104 refuses any issue description over 500 characters. Neither doc mentions that cap, and MCP_SERVER.md's qa_reject section lists only reason ≤2000 and issues ≤20.
   - The remedy alone is longer than the cap: HELD_REMEDY_UNTOUCHED + HELD_REMEDY_WITNESS + HELD_REMEDY_NEVER in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/recordCommit.ts:24-30 run to about 700 characters.
   - So for a held-path landing gap, the reject the docs prescribe is refused with INVALID_INPUT, and QA truncates the evidence or stalls.

EVIDENCE
Vitest repros, run in a git-archive snapshot of HEAD (/tmp/hunt-21d6-B). Files and outputs are in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-21d671c1/B/.
- errorDataNextAction.test.ts drives the real assertWorkerHoldsTask refusal through McpAdapter.handle. repro-error-data-nextAction.out shows no nextAction in data:
  `WIRE ERROR: {"code":-32002,"message":"[TASK_NOT_CLAIMED] Task task-x is not claimed by any worker, … Claim it first with moe.claim_next_task {…}","data":{"tool":"moe.start_step","codeName":"TASK_NOT_CLAIMED"}}`
- qaRejectLandingGap.test.ts builds the `Landing gap:` description exactly as the docs prescribe, with the verbatim held remedy. repro-qa-reject-landing-gap.out:
  `DESCRIPTION LENGTH: 1155` / `REFUSAL: [INVALID_INPUT] Invalid issues.description: too long (1155 chars). Maximum 500 characters.`

FIX DIRECTION
- architect.md:30: reword in place. The file is at 39 lines and `npm run lint` caps it at 40, so add no line. The new rule: on a MoeError, key on `error.data.codeName` and follow the call that `error.message` names.
- qa.reference.md (exempt from the cap) and moe-qa-loop SKILL.md:61:
  - state the 500-character cap on each issue description;
  - keep the issue to the codes, refs and paths;
  - put the printed remedy text in `reason` (max 2000) or quote it in a task comment.
  qa.md:16 lists no remedy, so it needs no change.
- Regenerate both vendored copies; see mem:gotcha-moe-doc-generated-artifacts:
  - packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts (generate-init-files);
  - packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/skillFiles.ts (generate-skill-files).
  Run the generators in a clone that has history, never as npm build/clean in the shared checkout (global rail). Apply their few-line diff hunks with the session's Edit tool, not cp: global rail on TOOL witnesses.
- qaCommitPolicy.test.ts guards the 'Landing gap:' sentinel (util/qaCommitPolicy.test.ts:31). Keep it green.

FILES: docs/roles/architect.md, docs/roles/qa.reference.md, docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md, packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts, packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/skillFiles.ts. The last two are regenerated output.
OUT OF SCOPE:
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md, held by task-66108835 and task-3e1d0c2e.
- docs/roles/qa.md.
- The using-git-worktrees skill's shared-mode-only landing text, which is held back for a later hunt.
definitionOfDone: `grep -rn 'error\.data\.nextAction' docs/roles docs/skills packages/moe-daemon/src/generated` prints nothing. architect.md's MoeError rule names `error.data.codeName` and says to follow the call that `error.message` names. `npm run lint` at the repo root passes, so architect.md stays at or under 40 lines.

`grep -n '500' docs/roles/qa.reference.md docs/skills/moe-qa-loop/SKILL.md` shows the issue-description cap in two places: qa.reference.md's landing-gap reject paragraph and SKILL.md's landing-gap bullet. Both route the held-path remedy text to `reason` (max 2000) or a task comment, not to the issue description.

Both vendored copies match the edited docs. In a clone of the fix commit that has history (mem:gotcha-moe-doc-generated-artifacts), `npm run generate-init-files && npm run generate-skill-files` leaves `git status --short src/generated` empty, and `npx vitest run src/util/initFiles.test.ts src/util/skillFiles.test.ts src/util/qaCommitPolicy.test.ts` passes.
